review_findings: The design passes exact compiled WorkflowSpec objects into the existing activation authority instead of modifying or duplicating global registries.
Registration remains a digest-bound provenance reference and is revalidated on every load.
Real SKILL.md sources are package members and receipts remain dependent on real Host execution.
Strict entrypoint/slash parsing prevents natural-language guessing from acquiring mutation effects.
The generic executor is injected with the existing Dispatcher, durable checkpointer, and existing TaskRun; it owns none of those authorities.
Arbitrary project commands and missing concrete adapters stay outside this change and fail closed at runtime.

skill_rule_mappings.assessment: registration stores provenance only; WorkflowSpec, graph parser, Resolver, Dispatcher, LangGraph, and TaskRun remain canonical owners
contract identity, package SKILL.md path, loaded digest, Host result, and receipt validation are all bound
effect preview identifies mutation but only the existing injected Dispatcher Guard can permit an adapter call
memory checkpointers are rejected and runtime states project through workflow_taskrun_bridge
